events.name: Sydney Roosters v Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs
events.hook: The Roosters and Bulldogs open the final NRLW regular-season round under Thursday-night pressure.
events.context: The last home-and-away weekend fixes the six-team finals field and each club's route through it.

events.name: Wests Tigers v Canberra Raiders
events.hook: Wests Tigers and Canberra carry their finals ambitions into the last Friday of the regular season.
events.context: A result at Leichhardt can alter both qualification and the first-week finals matchup.

events.name: Parramatta Eels v North Queensland Cowboys
events.hook: Parramatta and North Queensland get one final regular-season measure before the finals bracket locks.
events.context: The midday match carries the direct consequences of a compressed eleven-round campaign.

events.name: Cronulla-Sutherland Sharks v St George Illawarra Dragons
events.hook: Cronulla and St George Illawarra meet in a shifted Allianz Stadium double-header with finals positions at stake.
events.context: The final-round move adds a big-stage test just before elimination football begins.

events.name: Brisbane Broncos v New Zealand Warriors
events.hook: Brisbane closes its regular season against a Warriors side full of familiar Queensland connections.
events.context: The Sunday result can decide whether the defending premiers earn a shorter finals route.

events.name: Newcastle Knights v Gold Coast Titans
events.hook: Newcastle and Gold Coast finish the NRLW regular season with the finals order on the line.
events.context: The last scheduled match can redraw the elimination pairings only days before finals begin.

events.name: Roosters v Broncos
events.hook: Roosters and Broncos meet for the NRLW premiership at Accor Stadium.
events.context: The NRLW Grand Final starts at 4 pm Sydney time on 4 October, before the men’s decider at the same venue. Daylight saving begins that morning in Sydney; Queensland viewers have a 3 pm start.

events.name: China v Czechia
events.hook: China and Czechia meet with direct quarterfinal qualification still shaping the group.
events.context: Every possession matters before the tournament turns into knockout basketball in Berlin.

result.recapText: China beat Czechia 74-70 after overtime in the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup group stage.

events.name: Puerto Rico v Belgium
events.hook: Puerto Rico and Belgium collide in a group game with knockout seeding attached.
events.context: The result helps determine who advances directly and who must survive qualification.

result.recapText: Puerto Rico 64–76 Belgium in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Italy v USA
events.hook: Italy gets the tournament benchmark against the USA before the bracket takes shape.
events.context: This late group game carries both a heavyweight test and direct quarterfinal implications.

result.recapText: Italy 52–55 USA in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Belgium v Australian Opals
events.hook: The Opals face Belgium with a direct quarterfinal place and a cleaner title route in play.
events.context: Australia's last group assignment is the sharpest test of its Berlin campaign before knockout basketball.

result.recapText: Belgium 80–68 Australian Opals in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Puerto Rico v Türkiye
events.hook: Puerto Rico and Türkiye close their group with the qualification line in reach.
events.context: The final pool result will settle the route into the World Cup's knockout phase.

result.recapText: Puerto Rico 75–71 Türkiye in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Hungary v Korea
events.hook: Hungary and Korea have one last group-stage chance to improve their knockout path.
events.context: The match lands in the final pool round, when qualification and seeding are resolved together.

result.recapText: Hungary 82–73 Korea in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Nigeria v France
events.hook: Nigeria and France finish their group with the bracket and a direct quarterfinal route at stake.
events.context: The last round removes the safety net: position now determines the road through Berlin.

result.recapText: Nigeria 56–111 France in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Japan v Spain
events.hook: Japan and Spain bring contrasting styles into a decisive final group game.
events.context: Tempo and half-court execution will help decide who gets the shorter knockout route.

result.recapText: Japan 59–79 Spain in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Germany v Mali
events.hook: Hosts Germany meet Mali with the home crowd and knockout positioning converging.
events.context: The final group night turns local expectation into an immediate bracket consequence.

result.recapText: Germany 83–58 Mali in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: USA v Czechia
events.hook: The USA closes its pool against Czechia with a direct quarterfinal route on offer.
events.context: Czechia's resistance and the final margin can reshape the knockout bracket.

result.recapText: USA 105–64 Czechia in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: Italy v China
events.hook: Italy and China finish the group phase in a direct test of knockout readiness.
events.context: The matchup is the last chance to improve seeding before elimination basketball begins.

result.recapText: Italy 51–71 China in the World Cup group stage in Berlin.

events.name: FIBA Women's World Cup — qualification day 1
events.hook: The first qualification games put World Cup survival on a single result.
events.context: Second- and third-placed teams meet for the remaining quarterfinal places.

events.name: FIBA Women's World Cup — qualification day 2
events.hook: The last qualification games complete the Women's World Cup quarterfinal field.
events.context: There is no pool-stage buffer now: winners advance and losers leave Berlin.

events.name: FIBA Women's World Cup — quarterfinals
events.hook: Four quarterfinals reduce the World Cup field to its final four in one Berlin day.
events.context: Group winners re-enter against qualification survivors, with every title route now direct.

events.name: FIBA Women's World Cup — semifinals
events.hook: The last four teams play for a place in the Women's World Cup final.
events.context: Two semifinals in one Berlin session decide who can still leave as world champion.

events.name: FIBA Women's World Cup — bronze medal game
events.hook: The semifinal losers have one final chance to leave Berlin with a World Cup medal.
events.context: The bronze game rewards the team that can reset fastest after missing the final.

events.name: FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup final
events.hook: Two teams remain for the Women's Basketball World Cup title in Berlin.
events.context: The tournament closes with forty minutes separating the finalists from a world championship.

events.name: Spain Sail Grand Prix — race day 2
events.hook: Valencia's second race day decides the fleet winner and shifts the championship run-in.
events.context: Thirteen national teams race identical F50s before the season moves to Geneva.

events.name: Geneva Sail Grand Prix — race day 1
events.hook: Lake Geneva opens the final European SailGP weekend of the 2026 season.
events.context: The tight waterfront course gives the thirteen-team fleet little room to recover from a poor start.

events.name: Geneva Sail Grand Prix — race day 2
events.hook: Geneva's final races turn European points into the qualification picture for the UAE finale.
events.context: The event winner and championship positions are decided before the two-event finish in the Emirates.

events.name: Dubai Sail Grand Prix — race day 1
events.hook: Dubai begins a back-to-back UAE finish with Grand Final qualification under pressure.
events.context: The penultimate event leaves the fleet only one weekend to repair any points damage.

events.name: Dubai Sail Grand Prix — race day 2
events.hook: Dubai's closing races lock in the final points before the fleet moves to Abu Dhabi.
events.context: A weak Sunday can turn a title campaign into a last-weekend recovery mission.

events.name: Abu Dhabi Sail Grand Prix — race day 1
events.hook: The Abu Dhabi Grand Final opens with the season championship still alive.
events.context: Fleet points set the finalists for SailGP's last winner-takes-all race of 2026.

events.name: Abu Dhabi Sail Grand Prix — championship day
events.hook: SailGP's last race crowns the 2026 champion in Abu Dhabi.
events.context: A full season of fleet racing ends in the championship's decisive final contest.
